name: directory.rename
description: Rename or move a directory. The same primitive handles both (POSIX rename(2) / Win32 MoveFileEx) — supplying a different parent path moves the directory. Atomic on the same filesystem; falls back to copy+delete across filesystems if `cross_fs` is true.

dst.description: Absolute destination directory path. May share the parent of `src` (pure rename) or differ (move).

overwrite.description: If true, replace an existing directory at `dst`. Without this, returns ERR already_exists when `dst` is occupied.

cross_fs.description: If true, allow a copy+delete fallback when `src` and `dst` are on different filesystems. Default refuses cross-filesystem renames with ERR cross_device.

fallback_used.description: Set to 'copy_delete' if cross_fs fallback ran; absent otherwise.

windows-modern.description: MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING when overwrite=true. Cross-volume moves use MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED when cross_fs=true; rejected otherwise.

windows-classic.description: MoveFile / MoveFileEx depending on NT version. NT 4 lacks MoveFileEx; the agent emulates overwrite via DeleteFile+MoveFile (non-atomic).
